title: Dental Assistants, Occupational Outlook Handbook
evidence: National May 2025 median $48,070; lower 10% below $37,130; upper 10% above $62,250; 2025–35 growth 7%; 53,000 average annual openings. Office setting and schedule.

title: Dental Assistants, 31-9091.00
evidence: Tasks and work characteristics: limited clinical duties directed by dentist, patient records, equipment, supplies, oral-care instructions, dexterity and communication. Broad task inventory is not state authorization.

title: Dental Assistant
evidence: Patient history and blood pressure; chairside support; solo, group, specialty, public-health, hospital and teaching settings. Used for occupational context, not current detailed CDA eligibility.

title: Become a Dental Assistant
evidence: Search-index passage describes seating patients, preparing instruments, assisting, post-treatment instructions and specialty work. Full-page requests timed out twice; source supports general workflow only.

publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
title: Sterilization and Disinfection
evidence: May 15, 2024: trained personnel, manufacturer instructions, cleaning before sterilization, processing sequence and distinction from surface disinfection.

publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
title: Standard Precautions
evidence: May 15, 2024: hand hygiene, PPE, sharps, sterile equipment and environmental surfaces apply to all patient care.

title: Find a Program
evidence: Programmatic accreditation and searchable accredited-program directory; not a guarantee of one program length.

title: Certified Dental Assistant
evidence: Current listed Pathways I–III, 3,500 approved hours in Pathway II, accepted hands-on CPR/BLS/ACLS, three component examinations. Future 2027 route intentionally omitted.

title: K.S.A. 65-1423
evidence: Subsections (a)(7), (a)(8), (b): supervised radiography, unlicensed dental services, prohibited acts and expanded-function distinctions. Nitrous oxide is excluded from statutory definition of general/local anesthesia; draft makes no nitrous authorization claim.

title: Dental Assistant FAQs
evidence: Official search-index answer confirms Board does not license or certify dental assistants. Direct open returned 403; do not characterize full page as inspected.

title: Career Pathways
evidence: Different dental-team roles: assistant, hygienist, laboratory technician, office manager, patient-service coordinator. Further education required for separate clinical professions.

title: Association home page
evidence: Education/advocacy and student/professional membership. Temporary site reports service transition; no claim that full learning portal is available.
